about: AI Office Overview is AI Head Office Overview's office without the project tools. Read by tools/head-office-check.mjs. swaps: [Head Office's words, this app's words], applied to Head Office's files before comparing. files: per file, what each known difference is (status keep, port or ours) and its lines (written by --accept).

onlyHere.public/setup.js: Setup window (Head Office: settings.js, which also holds the project settings)
onlyHere.src/update.mjs: Update button for a git clone
onlyHere.test/server.test.mjs: this app's own server (server.mjs; Head Office's is lib/)
onlyHere.src/install.mjs: the shortcuts and uninstall (Head Office: lib/setup.js and tools/setup.js, CommonJS)
onlyHere.src/windows.mjs: every call to Windows itself (Head Office: lib/platform/windows.js)
onlyHere.src/windows/shortcut.ps1: the three shortcuts (Head Office: lib/platform/windows/shortcut.ps1, desktop and startup only, no Start menu)
onlyHere.test/install.test.mjs: tests for the above (Head Office: test/setup.test.js)
onlyHere.tools/setup.mjs: install.cmd and uninstall.cmd's console tool (Head Office: tools/setup.js)
onlyHere.tools/make-icon.mjs: makes public/app.ico from icon.svg (Head Office ships a drawn app.ico)
onlyHere.src/files.mjs: writeJson, swapIn and readText with a retry on EPERM and EBUSY (Head Office: lib/settings.js swapIn)
onlyHere.tools/run-tests.mjs: npm test's runner: lists test/*.test.mjs so the tests run on Node 20 (Head Office needs Node 22)

onlyHeadOffice.public/checks.js: project tools: audit, git and live-site checks
onlyHeadOffice.public/projects.js: project tools: Projects tab, Run / Stop
onlyHeadOffice.public/settings.js: Settings window with project settings (this app's Setup window, public/setup.js, has the office part as tabs: Setup, Office, Update, Help, About)
onlyHeadOffice.src/tokens.mjs: project tools: token counts per project
onlyHeadOffice.test/tokens.test.mjs: project tools: token counts per project
onlyHeadOffice.public/backups.js: project tools: Backups (Settings › Backups, Run backups now)

missing: Demo office: a made-up office to try every reward (Head Office demo/, start-demo.cmd, Office bonus)

items.what: project tools only in Head Office: Filter by chooser, Projects tab tiles, Run / Stop, card Actions menu, notice line, This PC rings, audit / git / live marks, Prompts, planner, Settings rows
left column 190 px headed Projects, with state icons and counts; right panel 370 px (this app's layout)
sun / moon / auto switch, Setup > Update and the window rules sit in other places in the file
"Show general chit-chat" tick wording (Head Office says Hide); TOMLIN in two comments; select styled in Setup
project tools only in Head Office: Backups (the .bk-* rules for backups.js)
this app has no .proj-head / .proj-heading (Projects tab tiles) star sizes
P-03: the right panel gives way to 320 px under 1200 px; the fault line has a Close button; a fault line on the card
